dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and consistent 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior region of the visible frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity with a high-reflectance longitudinal dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Fine-grained, low-frequency dark-pixel speckling distributed across the dorsal surface, particularly on the right-lateral side.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the primary light-grey skin tone and localized pigmented clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast, circular dark aperture located at the anterior midline of the dorsal surface.
